propositions: review-bot git fetch hangs indefinitely on byte-starved connections due to missing http.lowSpeedLimit and http.lowSpeedTime config, bounded only by the 300s wall-clock timeout
a stalled fetch that accepts the connection but sends zero bytes can be detected and aborted within 10 seconds using throughput-keyed abort parameters instead of wall-clock timeout
a legitimately slow but progressing fetch must not be aborted by the low-speed parameters; the threshold is keyed on bytes-per-second throughput floor, not elapsed wall time
transient low-speed aborts should be retried in-process a bounded number of times to self-heal within the same review, while non-low-speed failures like auth errors should not be retried
the fix requires extracting git-subprocess and fetch-locking code from repo_snapshot.py into a new git_fetch.py module to stay within the 800 LOC module-size cap
